mapper.sql: SELECT t.tenant_id,m.member_id,t.owner_ref_id AS client_id FROM t_access_tenant t JOIN t_tenant_member m ON m.tenant_id=t.tenant_id JOIN t_tenant_member_role g ON g.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND g.tenant_member_id=m.member_id JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.member_type='OWNER' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND t.tenant_type='CLIENT' AND t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.security_status='ACTIVE' AND t.source_version >= 1 AND REGEXP_LIKE(t.source_payload_hash,'^[0-9a-f]{64}$','c') AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.role_scope_key=CAST(t.tenant_id AS CHAR) AND g.effective_from <= #{now} AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to > #{now}) AND r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.system_role=1 AND ((t.owner_status='PENDING' AND r.role_code='TENANT_ONBOARDING_OWNER') OR (t.owner_status='ACTIVE' AND r.role_code='TENANT_OWNER')) ORDER BY t.tenant_id,m.member_id
mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId,realm,account_type AS accountType,status FROM t_user_account WHERE account_id=#{id}

SELECT t.tenant_id,m.member_id,t.owner_ref_id AS client_id FROM t_access_tenant t JOIN t_tenant_member m ON m.tenant_id=t.tenant_id JOIN t_tenant_member_role g ON g.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND g.tenant_member_id=m.member_id JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.member_type='OWNER' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND t.tenant_type='CLIENT' AND t.owner_status='PENDING' AND t.security_status='ACTIVE' AND t.source_version >= 1 AND REGEXP_LIKE(t.source_payload_hash,'^[0-9a-f]{64}$','c') AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.role_scope_key=CAST(t.tenant_id AS CHAR) AND g.effective_from <= #{now} AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to > #{now}) AND r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.system_role=1 AND r.role_code='TENANT_ONBOARDING_OWNER' ORDER BY t.tenant_id,m.member_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: tenant_id AS tenantId, owner_ref_id AS ownerRefId, owner_status AS ownerStatus, source_version AS sourceVersion, source_payload_hash AS sourcePayloadHash, version
mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId, realm, account_type AS accountType, status FROM t_user_account WHERE account_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_access_tenant WHERE tenant_type='CLIENT' AND owner_ref_id=#{ownerRefId}
SELECT FROM t_access_tenant WHERE tenant_type='CLIENT' AND owner_ref_id=#{ownerRefId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT member_id AS memberId, account_id AS accountId FROM t_tenant_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_type='OWNER' ORDER BY member_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_role(role_id,tenant_scope,tenant_id,scope_key,role_code,role_name,status,system_role,version,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{id},'TENANT',#{tenantId},CAST(#{tenantId} AS CHAR),#{code}, CASE WHEN #{code}='TENANT_ONBOARDING_OWNER' THEN '入驻申请负责人' ELSE '客户工作区负责人' END, 'ACTIVE',1,1,#{now},#{now})
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM t_role WHERE tenant_scope='TENANT' AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND scope_key=CAST(#{tenantId} AS CHAR) AND role_code='TENANT_OWNER' AND system_role=1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_tenant_member_role g JOIN t_role r ON g.role_id=r.role_id SET g.status='REVOKED',g.effective_to=#{now},g.version=g.version+1,g.update_time=#{now} WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key AND r.role_code='TENANT_ONBOARDING_OWNER' AND r.system_role=1
